text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Now then, where was I in my reading—

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~, this place is so totally awesome♡
Did you find it just for me~?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Right~?
Let's make this our secret hideout, Honey♡

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! You walked home with him!?
For reaaal~!? Eeeeek~♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: There's no sign of anyone around... and yet—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It's quiet here... Here, I can—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That snorting sound... A deer, perhaps?
It's close—ugh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Not here either... not here either...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The rhythm of the waves... Seabirds in the distance...
My body is naturally blending in with nature—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, my senses... are growing sharper...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to finding a comfortable place,
Admire Groove's running showed even sharper form from that day on.
